name: Mei Fong Tan
bio:
Mei Fong Tan's journey into motorsport started with a childhood fascination for F1 races broadcasted on late-night television. After completing her engineering degree at the National University of Singapore, she pursued a master's in Motorsport Engineering in the UK. While she is relatively new to leading a team as a chief engineer, she is eager to apply her theoretical knowledge and learn from practical experience.

Mei Fong is a firm believer in data-driven decisions and meticulous preparation. She is known for her ability to quickly adapt to changing circumstances and find creative solutions to technical challenges. She values open communication and collaboration within her team, aiming to foster a supportive and innovative environment.

What sets Mei Fong apart is her unwavering commitment to precision and her ability to dissect complex problems into manageable components. She is a fast learner, dedicated to continuous improvement, and determined to make a significant impact in the world of motorsport.
